question.question: After an eligible Accept is acknowledged and contributes to the origin slow-path commitment, does the accepting peer preserve and report ACCEPTED-or-later support on a subsequent higher Prepare before receiving Commit, or is its prior preaccepted phase retained?
question.importance: Recovery distinguishes accepted support from preaccepted support when choosing whether to resume Accept or recompute a value. Misreporting support used by a completed quorum can undermine preservation of an established decision; global divergence is not yet demonstrated.
contexts: Slow-path commitment with peer Commit messages still in flight; higher Prepare before local Commit reception
event_paths: Conflicting proposals -> unequal PreAcceptReply metadata -> real bcastAccept -> eligible handleAccept -> matching AcceptReply -> origin commitment -> higher Prepare -> report phase

obligation.description: An accepting peer that processes an eligible Accept and acknowledges that ballot must retain an ACCEPTED-or-later classification for the accepted instance metadata. A subsequent Prepare before any intervening value change must report that classification, including when the origin has committed using this support but its Commit message has not reached the peer.

scope.description: Local phase fidelity of successfully accepted support across a later promise-only Prepare.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine peers, static membership, intact messages
Eligible Accept reaches the storage branch and its reply matches the request ballot
No intervening value-changing operation at the inspected peer
excluded: VBallot transport fidelity, covered by an independent check

grounding.derivation: A matching AcceptReply is counted by handleAcceptReply as successful accept support toward commitment. The receiver stores the proposed attributes on its eligible branch. handlePrepare exports Instance.Status as the phase of that retained support, and handlePrepareReply deliberately treats ACCEPTED as a stronger recovery case than PREACCEPTED. The PreAccept guard and findPreAcceptConflicts comment also protect ACCEPTED-or-later instances from regression. Composing these duties requires an eligible acceptor to represent its retained support as ACCEPTED or later until superseded by another legal value transition. The duty is phase fidelity of accepted support, not an assertion that a particular quorum formula is safe.
grounding.applicability: Same instance and accepting peer, eligible non-stale Accept acknowledged at the proposal ballot; no intervening value change or Commit installation before higher Prepare reports the state.
unresolved: No global agreement or recovery progress conclusion.
alternatives: Local ballot and attributes can be preserved while phase is misclassified.
Equal preaccepted recovery support or a later Commit can protect some wider histories without satisfying this local accepted-support representation duty.
